description: This file defines a REST API class 'LicenseAPI' for managing license entities in an HR management system. It includes methods for CRUD operations (create, read, update, delete), validation rules, and API documentation annotations. The class interacts with a LicenseService for business logic and uses data transfer objects and models for data representation.

classes.name: LicenseAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller supporting CRUD operations for License entities, with validation and API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single license by ID, throws not found exception if absent.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all licenses with optional sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new license with provided data.

methods.name: saveLicense
methods.description: Sets license name from request and persists the license entity.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing license identified by ID.

methods.name: getLicenseService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LicenseService instance.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for retrieving a single license.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for listing licenses.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a license.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a license.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Defines validation rules for deleting licenses.

methods.name: getNameRule
methods.description: Creates validation rule for the 'name' parameter, ensuring it's unique and within max length.
